purpose: Resolve the two remaining P2G source-product identity gaps without forcing seller claims into existing narrower canonical categories.
semantic_boundary: Seller material names, naturalness and grade remain source claims unless independently verified.
Rutilated Quartz Multi must not be forced into Gold Rutilated Quartz or Black Rutilated Quartz.
The Labradorite AAA source product retains the seller's conflicting size claims rather than normalizing them to one exact size.
All source-scoped variants remain unverified and do not select a quality tier or supplier route.

canonical_parent.description: Canonical category for rutilated quartz not restricted to gold- or black-rutile seller/color subcategories. Category identity does not verify any supplier product.
